_comment: Composite indexes required by the spine's wake queries.
Firestore cannot serve an equality filter plus a range filter on a different field without
one of these. Kept as code rather than created by clicking a console link, so the README's
reproducible setup is genuinely reproducible. Rules.md line 425 scores the spin up
instructions as proof the project can be rebuilt.

indexes._why: scan_due: find pending wakes whose time has arrived
scan_due: reclaim wakes whose worker died and whose lease has expired
for_run: list a course's whole wake ladder in due order, for cancellation and audit
